name: Surgeon's mate Isaac Van Voorhis in the officers' barracks
head: van_voorhis_isaac

present_on_scene_date.note: On the 31 May 1812 roll of the post's officers.

associated_with.note: An officer of the post; which room he had is not recorded.

not_in_this_household.note: Everyone the T-3461 sweep found in this household on 14 August is on the card.

persons.name: Isaac Van Voorhis

born.note: From aged 22 when writing in Oct 1811 (Quaife App. II). Not a register entry.

occupation.value: surgeon's mate, Heald's company, First Infantry
occupation.note: His rank as the muster-roll of the company to 31 May 1812 (Quaife 1913, Appendix VIII) prints it.

present_on_scene_date.note: Heald's official report and Journal name the four officers in the action. No source takes a roll call on the afternoon of 14 August 1812; this is read from the evidence below.

persons.note: After Irwin left on 5 July 1812 Van Voorhis held the keys of the factory (first_fort_outer_factory), whose goods Heald distributed on 14 Aug. After 14 August: Killed in battle near the baggage wagons; Wau-Bun's portrait of his cowardice is rejected by Quaife.
